#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# healthcheck.sh — Service Health Check Script
# Checks whether services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding and reports
# their status with clear, colour-coded output.
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SERVICES=(
  "Frontend:3000"
  "Backend:8080"
)
HOST="${HOST:-localhost}"
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-5}"          # seconds to wait for a response
HEALTH_PATHS=(
  "3000:/health"
  "8080:/health"
)

# ── Colour helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [[ -t 1 ]]; then             # only use colours when stdout is a terminal
  RED='\033[0;31m'
  GREEN='\033[0;32m'
  YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
  CYAN='\033[0;36m'
  BOLD='\033[1m'
  RESET='\033[0m'
else
  RED='' GREEN='' YELLOW='' CYAN='' BOLD='' RESET=''
fi

# ── Counters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PASS=0
FAIL=0

# ── Helper: look up the HTTP path configured for a given port ──────────────────
get_health_path() {
  local port="$1"
  for entry in "${HEALTH_PATHS[@]}"; do
    if [[ "${entry%%:*}" == "$port" ]]; then
      echo "${entry#*:}"
      return
    fi
  done
  echo "/"          # default to root if no specific path is configured
}

# ── Helper: check a single service ────────────────────────────────────────────
check_service() {
  local name="$1"
  local port="$2"
  local path
  path="$(get_health_path "$port")"
  local url="http://${HOST}:${port}${path}"
  local http_code
  local curl_exit

  # --- TCP connectivity check -------------------------------------------------
  if ! curl --silent --max-time "$TIMEOUT" \
            --output /dev/null \
            --write-out "%{http_code}" \
            "$url" &>/dev/null; then
    curl_exit=$?
  fi

  # Capture HTTP status code (0 if curl could not connect at all)
  http_code=$(curl --silent --max-time "$TIMEOUT" \
                   --output /dev/null \
                   --write-out "%{http_code}" \
                   "$url" 2>/dev/null) || true

  # --- Evaluate result --------------------------------------------------------
  local timestamp
  timestamp="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

  if [[ -z "$http_code" || "$http_code" == "000" ]]; then
    # Could not reach the service at all
    echo -e "${RED}[FAIL]${RESET} ${BOLD}${name}${RESET} (port ${port})"
    echo -e "       ${YELLOW}↳ No response from ${url}${RESET}"
    echo -e "       Timestamp : ${timestamp}"
    (( FAIL++ )) || true

  elif [[ "$http_code" -ge 200 && "$http_code" -lt 300 ]]; then
    # 2xx — healthy
    echo -e "${GREEN}[ OK ]${RESET} ${BOLD}${name}${RESET} (port ${port})"
    echo -e "       ${CYAN}↳ ${url} responded with HTTP ${http_code}${RESET}"
    echo -e "       Timestamp : ${timestamp}"
    (( PASS++ )) || true

  elif [[ "$http_code" -ge 300 && "$http_code" -lt 400 ]]; then
    # 3xx — redirect; service is reachable but may be misconfigured
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${RESET} ${BOLD}${name}${RESET} (port ${port})"
    echo -e "       ${CYAN}↳ ${url} returned HTTP ${http_code} (redirect)${RESET}"
    echo -e "       Timestamp : ${timestamp}"
    (( PASS++ )) || true   # reachable, so count as up

  else
    # 4xx / 5xx — service is up but returning an error
    echo -e "${RED}[FAIL]${RESET} ${BOLD}${name}${RESET} (port ${port})"
    echo -e "       ${CYAN}↳ ${url} returned HTTP ${http_code}${RESET}"
    echo -e "       Timestamp : ${timestamp}"
    (( FAIL++ )) || true
  fi
}

# ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main() {
  echo ""
  echo -e "${BOLD}════════════════════════════════════════${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}       Service Health Check Report      ${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}════════════════════════════════════════${RESET}"
  echo -e " Host    : ${HOST}"
  echo -e " Timeout : ${TIMEOUT}s"
  echo -e " Checked : $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
  echo -e "${BOLD}────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
  echo ""

  for service in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
    local_name="${service%%:*}"
    local_port="${service##*:}"
    check_service "$local_name" "$local_port"
    echo ""
  done

  # ── Summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  TOTAL=$(( PASS + FAIL ))
  echo -e "${BOLD}────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD} Summary${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
  echo -e " Services checked : ${TOTAL}"
  echo -e " ${GREEN}Healthy${RESET}           : ${PASS}"
  echo -e " ${RED}Unhealthy${RESET}         : ${FAIL}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}════════════════════════════════════════${RESET}"
  echo ""

  # Exit with a non-zero code if any service is down
  if [[ "$FAIL" -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo -e "${RED}[!] One or more services are not healthy. Exit code: 1${RESET}"
    echo ""
    exit 1
  else
    echo -e "${GREEN}[✓] All services are healthy.${RESET}"
    echo ""
    exit 0
  fi
}

main "$@"

  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}"

  echo "=============================================${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Host    : ${BOLD}${HOST}${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Timeout : ${BOLD}${TIMEOUT}s${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Time    : ${BOLD}$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')${RESET}"
  echo "---------------------------------------------"
}

}

    return $?
  fi

  fi
done

print_footer

# Summary line
echo ""
if $all_healthy; then
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}${GREEN}All services are healthy.${RESET}"
  exit_code=0
else
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}${YELLOW}⚠  One or more services are unavailable.${RESET}"

      echo -e "  ${RED}✘  ${SERVICES[$port]} on port ${port} is not responding.${RESET}"

  done
  exit_code=1
fi

echo ""

# =============================================================================
# healthcheck.sh — Service Health Check Script
# Checks whether services on ports 3000 and 8080 are reachable and reports
# their status with a clear summary.
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
HOST="${HEALTH_CHECK_HOST:-localhost}"
TIMEOUT="${HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT:-5}"   # seconds to wait for a response

declare -A SERVICES=(
  [3000]="Frontend"
  [8080]="Backend"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Formatting helpers
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
RED="\033[0;31m"
GREEN="\033[0;32m"
YELLOW="\033[0;33m"
CYAN="\033[0;36m"
BOLD="\033[1m"
RESET="\033[0m"

# Disable colours when not writing to a terminal (e.g. piped to a log file)
if [[ ! -t 1 ]]; then
  RED="" GREEN="" YELLOW="" CYAN="" BOLD="" RESET=""
fi

print_header() {
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}"
  echo "============================================="
  echo "          SERVICE HEALTH CHECK              "
  echo "=============================================${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Host    : ${BOLD}${HOST}${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Timeout : ${BOLD}${TIMEOUT}s${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Time    : ${BOLD}$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')${RESET}"
  echo "---------------------------------------------"
}

print_footer() {
  local passed=$1
  local failed=$2
  local total=$(( passed + failed ))

  echo "---------------------------------------------"
  if [[ $failed -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo -e "${BOLD}${GREEN}  ✔  All ${total}/${total} services are healthy.${RESET}"
  elif [[ $passed -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo -e "${BOLD}${RED}  ✘  All ${total} service(s) are unreachable.${RESET}"
  else
    echo -e "${BOLD}${YELLOW}  ⚠  ${passed}/${total} services healthy — ${failed} service(s) need attention.${RESET}"
  fi
  echo "============================================="
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Port check — tries nc first, then curl as a fallback
# Returns 0 (reachable) or 1 (unreachable), and sets RESPONSE_TIME
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
RESPONSE_TIME="N/A"

check_port() {
  local host=$1
  local port=$2
  local start end

  start=$(date +%s%3N)   # milliseconds

  if command -v nc &>/dev/null; then
    nc -z -w "${TIMEOUT}" "${host}" "${port}" &>/dev/null
    local status=$?
  elif command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    curl --silent --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
         --output /dev/null \
         "http://${host}:${port}" &>/dev/null
    local status=$?
  else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}  Warning: neither 'nc' nor 'curl' found; cannot check ports.${RESET}" >&2
    return 2
  fi

  end=$(date +%s%3N)
  RESPONSE_TIME=$(( end - start ))

  return $status
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
main() {
  local passed=0
  local failed=0

  print_header

  # Iterate over ports in sorted order for consistent output
  for port in $(echo "${!SERVICES[@]}" | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -n); do
    local name="${SERVICES[$port]}"

    printf "  %-12s (port %-5s) ... " "${name}" "${port}"

    check_port "${HOST}" "${port}"
    local result=$?

    if [[ $result -eq 0 ]]; then
      echo -e "${BOLD}${GREEN}UP${RESET}   ${CYAN}(${RESPONSE_TIME} ms)${RESET}"
      (( passed++ ))
    elif [[ $result -eq 1 ]]; then
      echo -e "${BOLD}${RED}DOWN${RESET} ${YELLOW}(no response after ${TIMEOUT}s)${RESET}"
      (( failed++ ))
    else
      echo -e "${BOLD}${YELLOW}UNKNOWN${RESET} (missing required tool)"
      (( failed++ ))
    fi
  done

  print_footer "$passed" "$failed"

  # Exit with a non-zero code if any service is unhealthy
  [[ $failed -eq 0 ]]
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# healthcheck.sh — Service Health Check Script
# Checks whether services on ports 3000 and 8080 are accepting connections
# and reports their status.
# =============================================================================

# --- Configuration -----------------------------------------------------------
PORTS=(3000 8080)
HOST="${HEALTH_CHECK_HOST:-localhost}"
TIMEOUT="${HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT:-3}"       # seconds to wait per connection attempt
PORT_LABELS=(
  [3000]="Frontend"
  [8080]="Backend"
)

# --- Colour codes (disabled automatically when not in a terminal) -------------
if [[ -t 1 ]]; then
  RED="\033[0;31m"
  GREEN="\033[0;32m"
  YELLOW="\033[0;33m"
  CYAN="\033[0;36m"
  BOLD="\033[1m"
  RESET="\033[0m"
else
  RED="" GREEN="" YELLOW="" CYAN="" BOLD="" RESET=""
fi

# --- Helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
print_header() {
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}"
  echo "============================================="
  echo "         SERVICE HEALTH CHECK REPORT         "
  echo "=============================================${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Host    : ${BOLD}${HOST}${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Time    : ${BOLD}$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Timeout : ${BOLD}${TIMEOUT}s${RESET} per port"
  echo "---------------------------------------------"
}

print_footer() {
  local all_healthy="$1"
  echo "---------------------------------------------"
  if [[ "$all_healthy" == "true" ]]; then
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}${BOLD}Overall Status : ALL SERVICES HEALTHY ✔${RESET}"
  else
    echo -e "  ${RED}${BOLD}Overall Status : ONE OR MORE SERVICES DOWN ✘${RESET}"
  fi
  echo -e "${CYAN}=============================================${RESET}"
}

check_port() {
  local port="$1"

  # Prefer 'nc' (netcat); fall back to /dev/tcp (bash built-in)
  if command -v nc &>/dev/null; then
    nc -z -w "${TIMEOUT}" "${HOST}" "${port}" &>/dev/null
  else
    # /dev/tcp approach — run in a subshell with a timeout
    (
      exec 3<>/dev/tcp/"${HOST}"/"${port}"
    ) &>/dev/null
    local pid=$!
    # Give it TIMEOUT seconds
    local elapsed=0
    while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do
      sleep 1
      (( elapsed++ ))
      if (( elapsed >= TIMEOUT )); then
        kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
        return 1
      fi
    done
    wait "$pid"
  fi
}

# --- Main --------------------------------------------------------------------
main() {
  print_header

  local all_healthy="true"
  local results=()

  for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    local label="${PORT_LABELS[$port]:-Service}"
    local status_text status_icon color

    if check_port "$port"; then
      status_text="UP"
      status_icon="✔"
      color="${GREEN}"
    else
      status_text="DOWN"
      status_icon="✘"
      color="${RED}"
      all_healthy="false"
    fi

    # Store result string for display
    results+=("$(printf "  %-12s port %-6s %b" "${label}" "${port}" "${color}${BOLD}${status_icon} ${status_text}${RESET}")")
  done

  # Print all results
  for line in "${results[@]}"; do
    echo -e "$line"
  done

  print_footer "$all_healthy"

  # Exit 0 = all healthy, Exit 1 = one or more services are down
  [[ "$all_healthy" == "true" ]]
}

main
